'''Francesc Xavier Gil Sánchez''' (born 24 May 1982), commonly known as '''Xavier Gil''', is an [[Andorra]]n [[Association football|footballer]], who currently plays for [[FC Santa Coloma]] and [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]].

==International career==
Gil made his debut on 21 August 2002, coming on as a substitute for [[Justo Ruiz]] in a 3–0 friendly match defeat against [[Iceland national football team|Iceland]].{{cn|date=October 2025}} He has been capped three times.{{cn|date=October 2025}}
